gaps.summary: Production MCP Server Registry, MCPToolPolicy persistence, admin approval workflow and application DI are not yet wired.
The trusted MCPHTTPTransport port is defined, but the production TLS/SNI-aware pinned-IP HTTP/SSE implementation, response byte budget and transport hardening are not yet bound.
MCP 2026-07-28 permits JSON Schema 2020-12; P0 maps only the subset NODE-25 can enforce and rejects unsupported keywords rather than silently weakening validation.
MRTR input_required is sanitized and fail-closed; durable LUMI-owned approval/input collection and bounded resume with inputResponses/requestState is not yet implemented.
Organization/server-bound credential contracts exist, but production Secret Manager, delegated-user OAuth/EMA principal mapping, refresh and revocation are not composed.
2025-11-25 compatibility is isolated and deterministically tested; broader real-server/SDK compatibility and conformance matrix evidence remains future validation.
Hosted GitHub Actions cannot receive a runner while the repository account payment/spending-limit condition persists; no hosted PASS may be claimed.
